excerpt: Taking possession on Dwarka Expressway in 2026? Here's the exact interior design planning timeline to follow before, during, and after handover.

contentHtml:
If you're taking possession of a Dwarka Expressway apartment in 2026, your interior design planning should start 60-90 days before your builder hands over the keys, not after — because the single biggest cause of delayed move-ins on this corridor is buyers who wait until possession day to start designing a bare-shell home that typically needs 90-120 days of interior work.

Dwarka Expressway (Northern Peripheral Road) has moved from a construction corridor to a possession corridor. Projects across sectors 99 to 113 — including Godrej Meridien in Sector 106, Experion Windchants in Sector 112, SmartWorld One DXP and M3M Capital in Sector 113, and Sobha City in Sector 108 — are at ready-to-move or advanced-completion stages, with several builders processing 2026 handovers. This guide gives you the planning sequence to follow so your interiors are ready close to the day you get your keys, not months after. If you're weighing whether to start now, our new-possession interior design checklist covers what to verify at handover in more detail.

Why 2026 Is a Pivotal Possession Year for Dwarka Expressway

Dwarka Expressway was one of Gurgaon's most construction-heavy corridors through the early-to-mid 2020s. That construction wave is now converting into deliveries: a meaningful share of the corridor's launched inventory from 2018-2021 is reaching occupancy certificate (OC) and possession stage in 2025-2026.

  • The opportunity: You're getting a genuinely bare shell — complete design freedom, unlike older corridors such as Sohna Road or Sushant Lok.
  • The risk: Bare-shell interior work takes 90-120 days for a full 3BHK or 4BHK, and if you only start planning after possession, you're paying EMI and rent simultaneously for months longer than necessary.

The Interior Planning Timeline: What to Do and When

90-60 Days Before Expected Possession — Start the Design Process

  • Get your builder floor plan and RERA-approved layout to your interior designer for a 3D design and material palette to begin, even before you can physically access the unit.
  • Finalise budget and scope (modular kitchen, wardrobes, false ceiling, electrical layout, furniture) so decisions are already made at possession.
  • Ask your interior partner to prepare an MEP point-of-view in advance, since provisions vary by builder and need confirming against the plan.

Possession Day to Day 15 — Site Verification & Snagging

  • Conduct a documented snagging inspection (flooring, plumbing points, electrical points, waterproofing, door/window fitting) before sign-off, ideally with your interior designer present.
  • Confirm the exact clear carpet area on-site against the sale agreement.
  • Submit your society/RWA interior work request and sort material movement/labour passes early — congestion is common when many owners take possession around the same time.

Day 15 to Day 100+ — Execution

  • Weeks 1-2: Electrical and plumbing first-fix, false ceiling framing, layout-defining civil work.
  • Weeks 3-7: Flooring, wall finishes, kitchen platform and modular carcass installation, wardrobe carcasses.
  • Weeks 8-12: Modular kitchen shutters and accessories, wardrobe finishing, false ceiling completion, painting, fixture installation.
  • Weeks 13-16: Furniture, soft furnishings, deep cleaning, documented quality walkthrough.

Three Mistakes Dwarka Expressway Possession-Year Buyers Make

1. Waiting for the final possession letter before contacting a designer — losing 60-90 days of parallel design/procurement time.

2. Underestimating how many neighbours are renovating at the same time — book your RWA renovation slot early.

3. Not confirming builder-provided fittings before ordering your own — confirm what's included in handover before finalising scope.

Why Bare-Shell Dwarka Expressway Buyers Choose a Turnkey Partner

A bare-shell possession is the best-case scenario for interior design — but only if design, procurement, and execution are coordinated tightly. The Omega Group's turnkey model handles concept, 3D visualisation, material selection, site supervision, and delivery under one accountable team, with 90% on-time delivery and 70+ quality checks per project.

faqs.question: When should I start interior design planning for my Dwarka Expressway possession?
faqs.answer: Start 60-90 days before your builder's expected possession date, using the RERA-approved floor plan to finalise design before you physically access the unit.

faqs.question: How long does interior design take for a bare-shell Dwarka Expressway apartment?
faqs.answer: 90-120 days from design freeze to handover for a full 3BHK or 4BHK.

faqs.question: Which Dwarka Expressway projects are seeing possession activity in 2026?
faqs.answer: Several projects across Sector 106, 108, 112, and 113 are at ready-to-move or advanced-completion stages. Confirm your specific handover schedule with your developer.

faqs.question: Should I hire an interior designer before or after taking possession?
faqs.answer: Before — so design and material selection run in parallel with your builder's final handover formalities.

faqs.question: What should I check during snagging before starting interior work?
faqs.answer: Flooring, electrical points, plumbing points, waterproofing, door/window fitting, and the exact clear carpet area on-site.
